control.shareTooltip: Share the invitation (PIN + link) via the share sheet or clipboard
control.shareScreenTooltip: Open the projection screen to share the QR code
control.shareCopied: Invitation copied (PIN + link) to the clipboard.
control.screenButtonTooltip: Opens the large screen to project (spectator view)
control.captureHint: ⓘ Players will be informed at startup. Keeps each player's answer details for individual tracking.
control.trackingHint: ⓘ On, results are recorded under each participant’s account (archived leaderboard, history). Off, no individual result is kept — only the group’s overall results. The live game is unaffected.
control.trackingOpenAccessHint: ⓘ Unavailable in open access: participants have no account, nothing individual is kept.
control.ownNameLabel: Let participants pick their display name
control.ownNameHint: ⓘ Off, the name shown comes from their account. Either way their results stay attached to it — a chosen name is not anonymity.
control.accessAccount: Accounts required: each participant signs in before joining.
control.accessOpen: Open access: the PIN and a nickname are enough, no account.
control.lockLabel: Close the room to new participants
control.lockHint: ⓘ Nobody else can join, even with the PIN. Those already in come back after a lost connection. Until the room closes.
control.lockTooltip: Close the room: nobody else can join, even with the PIN
control.unlockTooltip: Reopen the room to new participants
control.audioTargetLabel: Who hears the sound in this quiz
control.audioTargetHint: Replaces the quiz's setting, this time. Questions with their own setting keep it.
control.preloadNotice: So that nothing waits, the participants' devices receive the next question's image, sound or video a few seconds before it appears — never its text nor its answers. A tech-savvy participant could open them early.
control.startTooltip: Wait until most players are connected before starting
control.modeManualTooltip: Manual mode: you move to the next question yourself
control.modeAutoTooltip: Auto mode: automatically moves to the next question after each result
control.banConfirmDescription: The player is removed immediately and won't be able to return with this nickname for the chosen duration.
control.endTooltip: Warning: the room will be closed (PIN invalidated, participants disconnected). This cannot be undone.
control.endConfirmDescription: The room will be closed for good: the PIN is invalidated and participants are disconnected. This action cannot be undone.
control.archiveHint: The leaderboard and statistics stay available in History.

joinAddressHelp.why: Participants’ phones open this address to join. “localhost” or “127.0.0.1” only work on this computer: a phone cannot reach them, so the QR code and the link would lead nowhere.
joinAddressHelp.whereTitle: On a local instance, use this computer’s network address
joinAddressHelp.where: (an IP like 192.168.x.x), keeping the port of this page{{port}}:
joinAddressHelp.mac: Mac: System Settings › Wi‑Fi › Details… next to your network › IP address (or Network › your connection).
joinAddressHelp.windows: Windows: Settings › Network & internet › Wi‑Fi (or Ethernet) › your network › IPv4 address.
joinAddressHelp.linux: Linux: the network indicator › connection details, or “ip a” in a terminal.
joinAddressHelp.sameNetwork: Phones must be on the same Wi‑Fi / network as this computer, and its firewall must let the port through.
joinAddressHelp.deployed: On a server with a domain name, set APP_PUBLIC_URL in the configuration: it is then offered first.
joinAddressHelp.publicConfigured: This instance is configured with a public address ({{url}}): use it, it is the one participants can reach from anywhere.
joinAddressHelp.lanKnown: The addresses listed are this machine’s on the local network: pick the one of the network the participants are on (Wi‑Fi, wired).
joinAddressHelp.lanHidden: This instance runs in Docker Desktop (or a container on a bridge network), which hides the computer’s network: no local address could be detected. Type it below — or add HOST_LAN_IPS=<your IP> to the .env file (or “-e HOST_LAN_IPS=…” on docker run) so it is listed here next time.
joinAddressHelp.https: This page is served over HTTPS: an http:// local address will show a warning on phones — a public address with a certificate is the clean way.

control.restartMedia: Restart the media from the top
control.seekListening: The answers open when the sound ends: it cannot be moved until then.
control.pauseListening: Pauses the game while the sound is being listened to.
control.nextQuizTooltip: Play another quiz in this room: the participants stay in
control.changeQuizTooltip: Replace the quiz picked, before it starts
control.nextQuizDescription: The participants stay in the room and meet again in the next quiz’s lobby. Nobody types the PIN again.
control.changeQuizDescription: Nobody has played this quiz yet: the participants stay in the room and the lobby shows the new one.
control.closeQuizTooltip: Stop this quiz here and pick another: the participants stay in the room
control.closeQuizDescription: This quiz stops here. The participants stay in the room and meet again in the next quiz’s lobby; nobody types the PIN again.
control.archiveSoFarLabel: Keep what was played so far
control.archiveSoFarHint: Archived as interrupted in History, and counted in the room’s standings.
control.noPlayableQuiz: No other ready quiz. Mark a quiz ready in the editor to play it here.

sounds.title: Room sound
sounds.hint: The projection plays all of it. Participants following from home also hear the music and the effects; phones in the room stay silent.
sounds.dingLabel: A sound as each question starts
sounds.gongLabel: A sound when the question ends
sounds.countdownLabel: A countdown over the last five seconds, the end sound on zero
sounds.dingWhen: When each question appears — not for a question that plays its own sound or video.
sounds.tickWhen: Each time an answer comes in.
sounds.countdownWhen: Over the last five seconds of the time: tic on the second, tac on the half; the last tac is left out and the gong falls on zero. Stops if everyone has answered.
sounds.gongWhen: When the question ends: on zero, or as soon as everyone has answered.
sounds.musicWhen: Loops while players answer, from the moment the answers open. It steps out while a question plays its own sound or video, and between questions, then comes back where it was.
sounds.roomSoundHint: On: the projection plays the quiz, the music and the effects at the levels below.
sounds.roomMutedHint: Off: the projection is silent. The levels below are kept for when it is back.
sounds.mediaWhen: The quiz's own sound: a question's or a slide's sound, and the videos'. On the projection only: a participant at home still hears the question.

control.lookBackPrev: Look back at the previous step
control.lookBackNext: Look at the next played step
control.playedHint: A played step opens again for everyone, read-only: nothing is replayed.
control.reviewBannerText: Everyone sees it again. Nothing is replayed and no points change; the game waits where it was.
control.motionOnTooltip: The screens move between steps. Click to keep them still, for a slow projector.
control.motionOffTooltip: The screens change without transitions. Click to bring the transitions back.

screen.mediaLoading: The question is on its way…
screen.waitingHostText: The game picks up where it stopped as soon as the host is back.

player.presenceRoomHint: I can see the big screen

rules.multiple_choice: Several correct answers — tick them all, then submit. All or nothing.
rules.text_input: Type your answer — case, accents and extra spaces are ignored.
rules.numeric: Enter a number — close enough counts.
rules.ordering: Put the options in the right order, then submit. All or nothing.
rules.poll: No right answer, no points — just your opinion.
rules.numeric_closest: Enter a number — the closest answer wins.
rules.multiple_choice_partial: Several correct answers — each right tick counts, each wrong one cancels one.
rules.ordering_partial: Put the options in the right order — every right position counts.
rules.text_input_lenient: Type your answer — small typos are forgiven.
rules.image_choice_multi: Several right pictures — tick them all, then submit. All or nothing.
rules.image_choice_multi_partial: Several right pictures — each right tick counts, each wrong one cancels one.
